description: Closed-loop sensorless six-step at the rig duty ceiling (0.17), commutated from measured back-EMF zero crossings. Settles at 52.4 rad/s electrical.
notes: Captured live over mmc-proto at 990 Hz effective; 7949 frames, 0 rejected.
Matched-speed pair with if.csv: same rotor, same 12.07 V bus, same session.
Torque is matched by construction — both legs hold the same steady speed against the same unloaded rotor friction, so average torque is equal and current is a result.
Current-vector ripple 27.5 % sd / 136 % pk-pk; commutation-interval jitter 19.5 % sd.

Lock at this handoff is not reliable: 4 of 5 starts capture lock at ~52.4 rad/s, 1 of 5 collapses to ~17.3 rad/s with duty pinned and ~4x current. The 50.3 rad/s handoff is only 1.26x the measured 40 rad/s back-EMF sensing floor. This capture is a locked run.
title: Matched-speed comparison: six-step closed loop at 52.3 rad/s el
